data.name: Mayhem Fortress
data.detailed_description:
JOIN US


Roadmap


About the Game

DEPLOY. DESTROY. RECLAIM.

Mayhem Fortress is a session-based, post-apocalyptic third-person shooter where you pilot heavily armed mechas to reclaim a world overrun by rogue AI and hostile creatures. Drop into dangerous zones, complete high-risk missions, and fight your way through relentless enemies to secure valuable resources and restore control.

Prepare your loadout, enter the battlefield, and survive long enough to extract.

PILOT YOUR MECHA

Step into a powerful combat mecha operated by a human pilot and built for frontline warfare. Customize your machine with devastating weapons like miniguns, flamethrowers, cannons, and heavy rifles, and modify your setup with upgrades and skills that define your playstyle. Use mobility systems like jet-powered dodges to outmaneuver enemies, or engage in brutal close-range combat when things get intense.

SESSION-BASED COMBAT

Each mission is a focused, time-limited deployment where every decision matters. Select your mission, adjust difficulty, and enter hostile territory filled with unpredictable threats. Complete objectives, eliminate enemies, and extract safely to earn experience and resources. Progress through missions, improve your build, and take on greater challenges as you push deeper into dangerous zones.

A WORLD OVERRUN

Fight across a devastated world where abandoned industrial zones, deserts, and wild landscapes have fallen under the control of two dominant threats. The Dominion Protocol, once Helios’ planetary defense force, now operates as a rogue AI-driven mecha faction, enforcing its own cold logic and eliminating all human interference. Opposing them is the Aberrant Swarm, a terrifying mutant species born within Helios’ abandoned bio-facilities, spreading uncontrollably and evolving into increasingly dangerous forms. From coordinated machine assaults to relentless biological swarms and massive armored creatures, each encounter demands adaptation, positioning, and the right loadout to survive.

PROGRESS AND UPGRADE

Earn XP and in-game currency by completing missions and overcoming increasing difficulty levels. Upgrade your mecha, unlock new weapons, and refine your combat strategies. Replay missions to gain experience and master your builds while preparing for more dangerous operations ahead.

GROWING EXPERIENCE

Mayhem Fortress is actively in development, with more content planned including new missions, enemies, environments, and expanded gameplay systems. The battlefield will continue to evolve as we expand the world and deepen the combat experience.

data.short_description: Lead through the fires of conflict, set traps, maneuver, feign retreats, build sentry turrets, counter-attack and defend the line to protect your facility from evil forces.. Do not relent.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Greek, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 1.8GHz single core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 750 / Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent; AMD FX-8350 (8 * 4700) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
